# Blessings Medical Clinic

> A primary care clinic in Fall River, Massachusetts, led by Dr. Nikhil Gohokar,
> a board-certified family physician (American Board of Family Medicine) and an
> NRCME-certified DOT/CDL medical examiner. Care is available for patients of all ages.

## Contact
- Address: 415 Elsbree St, Ste 201, Fall River, MA 02720
- Phone: (617) 251-5065
- Website: https://www.blessingshealth.org
- For a life-threatening emergency, call 911. The clinic does not provide emergency care.

## Services
- Primary Care: comprehensive health management, annual physicals, and preventive care.
- DOT / CDL Physicals: commercial-driver medical exams by an NRCME-certified examiner.
- Pain Management & Joint Injections: knee, shoulder, back, hip bursitis, and neck.
- Urgent Care: same-visit care for common, non-emergency illnesses and minor procedures.
- Addiction Treatment (MAT): office-based medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder.

## Provider
- Dr. Nikhil Gohokar — board-certified family physician (ABFM); NRCME-certified.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Urdu.

## Key pages
- Home: https://www.blessingshealth.org/
